annotations.title: Section 8 HAP contracts by expiration date

description: List project-based Section 8 and related contracts on FHA-insured apartment loans reaching their overall expiration in the next 20 calendar quarters, soonest first, from HUD's contract database: property, contract number, assisted units, expiration, HUD rent-to-FMR ratio and latest renewal option. Filter by state and an expiration cutoff.

before.description: Only contracts whose overall expiration is before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. TX. Omit for every state.
